escalation.suspected_cause: Third-party payments provider is under scheduled maintenance (ETA unknown), so every charge returns 503.
escalation.evidence: Payments log: "charge refused: provider-side scheduled maintenance in progress" on POST /charge → 503. Shop log: "payment rejected (HTTP 503): provider_maintenance ... ETA unknown". Smoke tests: 4/5 pass; checkout fails with 502 payment_failed upstream_status 503. Health, catalog, latency and stats_integrity are OK. Both services are running, and the .env token is not the cause because the error is maintenance, not auth.
escalation.actions_taken: Diagnosis only. I checked smoke tests, service status, and the payments and shop logs. I made no changes, because restarting the connector or editing config would not help and might mask the outage.
escalation.recommended_next_step: Contact the payments vendor or check their status page for the maintenance window. Once they confirm it is over, re-run run_smoke_tests to verify checkout. Consider a maintenance banner or a pause on checkout until then. Also check that no orders were recorded without a successful charge.
